verdict: Paid Instagram lead generation is working well; cost per lead sits below industry norms with strong five-star reputation support.
diagnosis: This period generated 286 leads at $26.57 each on $7,598 spend — well under the $72 legal average on Meta.

signals.headline: 286 leads at $26.57 each
signals.detail: Cost per lead is roughly one-third of the legal category average on Meta. Volume and efficiency are both healthy this period.

signals.headline: $7,598 spent, 112,407 impressions
signals.detail: Reach hit 96,760 unique people. Frequency of 1.15 means ads are not overexposing the audience.

signals.headline: 1,470 landing page views, 2,107 link clicks
signals.detail: About 70% of clickers loaded the page. Drop-off between click and view is manageable but worth monitoring.

signals.headline: 58 new reviews, 5-star average
signals.detail: Reputation is a major asset. 593 total reviews at five stars gives strong social proof for cold Instagram traffic.

signals.headline: 130 call clicks, 29 followers
signals.detail: Phone demand is real but the Instagram profile itself is underbuilt. Followers and profile visits stay near zero.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Legal cost per lead on Meta
benchmark.body: <cite index="17-3,17-4">Legal services average around $72 per lead on Meta, with high competition driving costs up.</cite> Justice Consumer Law sits near $27 — well below that.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: <cite index="13-1">Legal cost per lead fell from $178 in June 2025 to $56 by May 2026.</cite> Q2 and early Q3 tend to be cheaper months for legal advertisers.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Meta beats Google for legal leads
competitor.body: <cite index="4-2">Median cost per lead runs about $325 on Google Ads versus $180 on Meta.</cite> Consumer law firms leaning into Meta are getting the better unit economics right now.

recommendations.title: Test a lead-quality question inside the Instant Form
recommendations.detail: <cite index="11-9,11-10">Stronger qualifying questions in lead forms help keep cost per lead in check.</cite> Consider adding one debt-amount or state question to filter noise.

recommendations.title: Speed up first-touch response to under five minutes
recommendations.detail: <cite index="8-8">Responding within 5 minutes makes conversion 21 times more likely than waiting 30.</cite> Worth auditing how fast intake reaches these 286 leads.

recommendations.title: Build the Instagram profile behind the ads
recommendations.detail: Followers sit at 29 and profile visits near zero. Test a weekly review-highlight or client-win post to warm the audience the ads are already reaching.
